baseline: Baseline — network as it operates today

steps.title: Move to a integrated programme supply chain
steps.detail: Consolidate programme-specific storage and distribution (EPI, malaria, TB/HIV) into the shared network. Modelled as a reduction in duplicated hub operating cost.
steps.owner: NDoH executive + programme managers + funding partners
steps.risk: The highest-value and hardest step. Programme funders must agree first.
steps.evidence: Integration policy lever changed between scenarios.

steps.title: Increase third-party transport share to 35%
steps.detail: Tender and contract commercial road transport for the affected lanes. Retain in-house capacity for lanes no commercial operator will serve.
steps.risk: Thin operator market outside the main corridors; verify before committing.
steps.evidence: Third-party share lever moved from 0% to 35%.
